name: the pier and the pier bar
notes: Origin = the platform center at map grade z = 0; the deck top is z = 1.2 (PIER_DECK_Y = WATER_Y + 1.9), pilings run to z = -4. The app draws pier 12 as a 3 m deck (175.1 m long); this model brings its own 16 x 20 m pier-head platform that starts exactly at the seaward end of that polyline (so the app deck and rails do not overlap it) and runs 20 m on along the last segment; the 10 x 14 m bar sits on it with 3 m of deck all round. Front (-Y) faces back up the pier toward Harbor Drive; the rail has a 3.6 m opening where the pier comes in. Atlas building 58 (a shop at the old pier-bar point) is the bar it replaces; hide it. distance_along_pier_m is the platform center measured from the land end, 10 m past the polyline end.
